                    orders.SP_ADR_22,
                    orders.SP_ADR_3,
                    orders.ord_num,
                    orders.PO_NUM,
                    ntfile.NOTES
                FROM 
                    DBO.ORD_LOG AS ord
                JOIN 
                    dbo.orders AS orders ON ord.ord_num = orders.ord_num
                JOIN
                    dbo.ntfile AS ntfile ON orders.ord_num = ntfile.nt_num
                WHERE  
                    ord.ord_num = 33339
            )
            SELECT 
                UT_DESC, 
                PROD_CD, 
                PC_UNIT, 
                SP_ADR, 
                SP_ADR_2, 
                SP_ADR_22, 
                SP_ADR_3,
                ord_num,
                PO_NUM,
                NOTES,
                order_qty,
                order_qty % PC_UNIT AS Remainder
            FROM 
                ExtractedNumbers
            ORDER BY 
                CASE 
                    WHEN ISNUMERIC(
                        LEFT(
                            UT_DESC,
                            CASE
                                WHEN CHARINDEX('-', UT_DESC) > 0 THEN CHARINDEX('-', UT_DESC) - 1
                                WHEN CHARINDEX(',', UT_DESC) > 0 THEN CHARINDEX(',', UT_DESC) - 1
                                ELSE LEN(UT_DESC)
                            END
                        )
                    ) = 1 THEN CAST(
                        LEFT(
                            UT_DESC,
                            CASE
                                WHEN CHARINDEX('-', UT_DESC) > 0 THEN CHARINDEX('-', UT_DESC) - 1
                                WHEN CHARINDEX(',', UT_DESC) > 0 THEN CHARINDEX(',', UT_DESC) - 1
                                ELSE LEN(UT_DESC)
                            END
                        ) AS INT)
                    ELSE 1
                END;
